summary.text: Sun Deity's Radiance is Jun Shen Guang's strongest immortal killer move. His body becomes a lump of light and erupts like a small sun.

claims.text: Faced with fatal danger from Fang Yuan’s closing Luo Po Valley method, Jun Shen Guang shouts and uses immortal killer move Sun Deity’s Radiance, his strongest method. His whole body turns into a lump of light and endless light erupts as if a small sun had appeared on the battlefield. Scalding white light of inexhaustible might makes Fang Yuan’s time path methods crumble wherever it goes, engulfs Southern Border immortals just freed, and dissipates the imitation regional wall over the five regional mountain range so mountain rocks crumble at the center. Aftereffects disturb other battlefields where Southern Border rank eights fight immemorial year beasts.

After he uses the trump card his aura falls to an extreme. The move expends huge white litchi immortal essence, permanently decreases his light path dao marks, and damages both enemy and self. Activating it inside the five regional mountain range also brings powerful backlash, so even after escaping he is seriously injured.
